svg.title: SVG Image created as EEG_RevC-Persistent analogue restart latch (Step 10).svg date 2026-11-08T13:24:01

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Firmware: on any stop drive RUN_REQUEST low; to start, confirm SYS_OK/PACK_OK, then low >=1 us, then high. Battery rebound cannot restart analogue power.

g.desc: Firmware: on any stop drive RUN_REQUEST low; to start, confirm SYS_OK/PACK_OK, then low >=1 us, then high. Battery rebound cannot restart analogue power.

g.text: ANA_ENABLE = SYS_OK . PACK_OK . SERVICE_OK . RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED (U220-U222 on reset logic sheet).

g.desc: ANA_ENABLE = SYS_OK . PACK_OK . SERVICE_OK . RUN_REQUEST . RUN_ARMED (U220-U222 on reset logic sheet).

g.text: Power-up: supervisors hold POWER_OK low for their release delay, so U227 starts cleared. CLK edges need <=10 ns/V: drive RUN_REQUEST directly from GPIO, no RC.

g.desc: Power-up: supervisors hold POWER_OK low for their release delay, so U227 starts cleared. CLK edges need <=10 ns/V: drive RUN_REQUEST directly from GPIO, no RC.

g.text: C7 STEP 10 / RESTART LATCH: FAULT CLEARS RUN_ARMED; RESTART NEEDS A NEW RUN_REQUEST RISING EDGE

g.desc: C7 STEP 10 / RESTART LATCH: FAULT CLEARS RUN_ARMED; RESTART NEEDS A NEW RUN_REQUEST RISING EDGE
